# fetch

Execute a FetchXML query against Dataverse

## Usage

```
ppds query fetch [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fetchxml` | yes | FetchXML query string. Can be omitted if using --file or --stdin. |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--count` | `-c` | `bool` |  | Include total record count in results |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--file` |  | `FileInfo` |  | Read FetchXML from a file |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--page` |  | `int?` |  | Page number (1-based) for paged results |
| `--paging-cookie` |  | `string` |  | Paging cookie from previous query for continuation |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--stdin` |  | `bool` |  | Read FetchXML from standard input |
| `--top` | `-t` | `int?` |  | Limit the number of results returned |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
